title: Three vehicles seized in Rochdale during police week of action on shop crime
excerpt: Officers made 19 vehicle stops in Rochdale as part of Safer Business Action Week, which led to 132 arrests across Greater Manchester.
body:
Police seized three vehicles and stopped 19 more in Rochdale during a week-long crackdown on shoplifting and other crime affecting shops across Greater Manchester.

The Rochdale activity was part of Safer Business Action Week, which Greater Manchester Police said resulted in 132 arrests, 1,122 store visits and 237 searches across the county.

Officers carried out plain-clothes operations, hotspot patrols, stop and search and targeted enforcement against prolific offenders, working alongside retailers and partner agencies.

Elsewhere, the force reported 28 arrests for shoplifting and 12 civil orders served in Manchester, shoplifting arrests in Bury, Bolton and Trafford, and multiple arrests and searches in Oldham.

Officers also gave crime prevention advice to businesses, workers and shoppers and promoted GMP's Bee in the Loop community messaging service, the force said.

Chief Inspector Paul Nolan, who led GMP's activity for the week, said: "We know the impact shoplifting and related offending can have on workers, who are too often subjected to harassment, abuse and violence. Those workers have our full support."

He added: "While this was a dedicated week of action, our work to tackle retail crime continues all year round. I would encourage any business experiencing issues to get in touch with their local neighbourhood team."

Safer Business Action Week is organised nationally by the National Business Crime Centre and brings police and local partners together to tackle crime affecting businesses, from convenience stores to shopping centres.

GMP did not give a breakdown of arrests in Rochdale. Businesses can contact their local neighbourhood policing team through the force's website or on 101.

Source: Greater Manchester Police press office, press release issued on 20 November 2026. Photograph: Rochdale Daily.
